reason: It's a brand-new name with zero reviews I can see, and I don't buy anything new on a creator's say-so alone. Plus I already fill up at the office fountain for free, so the filter plan feels like another subscription I'll forget to cancel.
objection: No reviews, no independent testing of what the filter actually removes, and I'm locked into a filter subscription with a brand that might not be around in a year.
would_change_my_mind: Hundreds of verified reviews plus independent lab results showing what the filter removes, and being able to buy the bottle without a plan at the $39.99 price.
